name: guest_subst
description: Managed-code substitutions for single-threaded soft-float zkVM guests (ILC stage)
note: No native object: this module carries the ILC-stage inputs. substitutions: ILLink.Substitutions XML that stubs or removes method bodies and folds feature fields; bflat applies it before the user's --substitution files and rejects duplicates, so users extend it and do not override it. snippets: C# compiled at guest-build time against the implementation assemblies, with access checks off; its method bodies replace the originals (see ZkvmSubstitutions.BuildBodySubstitutions). An entry is here for one of two reasons: the guest has one hart, or the method reaches a libm function that the nofp module traps. Soft-float arithmetic runs, so floating point alone is not a reason.
